youtubeTitle: Every law that finally caught up with justice took someone willing to be first in line for it.
caption:
Every law that finally caught up with justice took someone willing to be first in line for it.

Progress isn't just policy from the top. It's built by people who refuse to wait for permission to be treated equally - that instinct is as much a part of Viksit Bharat 2047 as any economic target.
